{{Quote|It would be nice to trust someone for change.|Unidentified Padawan to his Master.|<ref name="TOR">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
This '''Jedi Padawan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the war, he and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]], [[Jerbhen Hulis]], were tasked by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to discover the truth behind a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] turncoat who had been providing the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] with strategic information regarding the military movements of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. That informant, [[Exal Kressh]], managed to elude capture by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] throughout the war. In [[3678 BBY]], the Jedi Council gave the two one final chance to confront the Sith. They continued their search aboard the [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class warship]] ''[[Grace of Champalan Tides]]'', where they learned that the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] had received another communique from Kressh.

He and his Master tracked Kressh to [[Lenico Colony Blue]], a medical treatment facility orbiting Lenico IV, and to the planet's surface after Kressh destroyed the colony's orbiting system, trying to finish off [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], a Sith Apprentice sent by the Dark Council to kill Kressh, causing the colony to crash to the planet.

The Padawan and his master were on board the colony and survived its crash to the planet's surface. His master aided the survivors, while the Padawan left to seek aid, and located Teneb Kel's ship. On board he found [[Qawohl|Maggot]], Kel's friend and slave. With his Sith master way seeking parts to repair their ship, Maggot and the Padawan talked for some time in his language, meanwhile the Padawan's Master, Jerbhen Hulis, enlisted Kel to help him aid the survivors in exchange for his knowledge of what Kressh was planning. After gaining this information Kel made his way back to his ship. The Padawan was departing the ship, at the same time Kel arrived, saying goodbye to Maggot, the Padawan did not sense Kel, and was not aware of his presence, and was stabbed in the chest and killed by the Sith while his head was turned. Kel discarded his body, stating that he had promised the master to get the survivor's to safety and had said nothing of his Padawan.
